description: Source-first React visualization components for Recharts, D3.js, and Google Charts

parts.name: area-baseline
parts.title: Baseline Area
parts.description: Single-series area visualization showing values above and below an explicit quantitative reference baseline with truthful deviation semantics.

parts.name: area-basic
parts.title: Basic Area Chart
parts.description: Gradient area chart with smooth monotone interpolation.

parts.name: area-comparison
parts.title: Comparison Area
parts.description: Two-series area visualization for comparing a primary magnitude against a reference magnitude across an ordered domain, using restrained overlap, deterministic semantic identity, and shared Y-scale.

parts.name: area-gradient-depth
parts.title: Gradient Depth Area
parts.description: Single-series area visualization with a semantic fade-to-surface fill that adds restrained depth without encoding an additional variable.

parts.name: area-interactive
parts.title: Interactive Area
parts.description: Inspection-first area visualization with nearest-X selection, observation-aligned crosshair, keyboard navigation, and a persistent lockable tooltip.

parts.name: area-percent-stream
parts.title: Percent Stream Area
parts.description: 100% normalized stacked area chart for tracking how each contributor's share of the visible whole evolves over an ordered domain.

parts.name: area-prism
parts.title: Prism Area
parts.description: Single-series magnitude area chart with restrained semantic fill, explicit baseline semantics, and Plotcn shared inspection.

parts.name: area-range
parts.title: Range Area
parts.description: Bounded area visualization for showing a lower/upper envelope across an ordered domain, with optional central trend, truthful interval semantics, and explicit missing-bound behavior.

parts.name: area-stack-flow
parts.title: Stack Flow Area
parts.description: Additive multi-series stacked area chart with deterministic stack identity, truthful missing-value semantics, and contribution inspection.

parts.name: bar-basic
parts.title: Basic Bar Chart
parts.description: Categorical vertical bar chart with rounded caps and responsive tooltips.

parts.name: bar-bullet
parts.title: Bullet Bars
parts.description: Compact actual-versus-target bars for operational scorecards, with per-category target markers, truthful delta semantics, and responsive row-based inspection.

parts.name: bar-diverging
parts.title: Diverging Bars
parts.description: Signed categorical comparison around an explicit neutral reference, with truthful deviation geometry, symmetric scaling, touch-safe inspection, and neutral above/below semantics.

parts.name: bar-group-compare
parts.title: Group Compare Bars

parts.name: bar-interactive
parts.title: Interactive Bars

parts.name: bar-interval
parts.title: Interval Bars
parts.description: Floating range bars with explicit start and end bounds along a shared quantitative or temporal domain, truthful zero-width markers, and container-clamped tooltips.

parts.name: bar-percent-stack
parts.title: Percent Stack Bars
parts.description: 100% normalized stacked bars for comparing categorical composition while preserving raw contributor values, truthful zero/missing semantics, and stable stack identity.

parts.name: bar-signal
parts.title: Signal Bars

parts.name: bar-stack-ledger
parts.title: Stack Ledger Bars
parts.description: Additive stacked bars for multi-series categorical composition with stable contributor identity, truthful totals, and category-centric inspection.

parts.name: bar-variance
parts.title: Variance Bars
parts.description: Actual-versus-plan delta bars centered on a truthful zero-variance baseline, with neutral signed semantics and auditable source values.

parts.name: block-frame
parts.title: Dashboard frame

parts.name: chart-accessibility

parts.name: chart-state
parts.title: Chart State Fallbacks

parts.name: chart-tooltip
parts.title: Chart Tooltip Primitive
parts.description: High-contrast developer tooltip with tabular numbers and semantic token mapping.
